item.title: Sault Airport passenger numbers down in January

item.title: Vehicle tops 130 km/h on Sault street: Police
item.description: A vehicle travelled at twice the speed limit on Black Road, police say. The automobile allegedly hit 131 km/h in a 60 km/h zone on Feb. 4. The 20-year-old driver as charged with stunt driving. The vehicle as impounded for 14 days at the driver’s expense. The accused’s driving licence as suspended for 30 days. […]

item.title: Missing Sault teen found
item.description: A teenager missing for nearly a month has been found in safe condition. Tatiana Cugun-Maxwell, 13, was last seen Jan. 18 in the 300 block of Douglas Street. She was reported found by police in a release issued Thursday morning.

item.title: Hounds watch Martin's workload
item.description: The Soo Greyhounds may periodically rest captain Brady Martin in the coming weeks as they work to protect his shoulder. Head coach John Dean told team reporter Peter Ruicci on Tuesday that the club plans to closely monitor Martin’s workload following his return to the lineup, acknowledging that fatigue could increase the risk of re-injury.
